name: DUTASTERIDE / TAMSULOSIN 0.5/0.4MG 30 CAPSULES GSK
description: The combination of Dutasteride 0.5 mg / Tamsulosin 0.4 mg capsules is primarily used to treat moderate to severe symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), a common condition in older men that causes enlargement of the prostate gland. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
